test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'STATE' is written as ‘19-20-1-20-5’ and ‘HOME’ is written as ‘8-15- 13-5’. How will 'TELEVISION' be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic**: Place value of the letter = Code of that letter.

For, 'STATE' is written as ‘19-20-1-20-5’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ae0ceea08697a3f42fff541f3e45892fdeb9a0257137745f514795412efe587.png] 

For, ‘HOME’ is written as ‘8-15- 13-5'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a2a0031083926b742d6bd81e91880e47c129c904201241dd15dcac7254e7d3.png] 

Similarly, for 'TELEVISION'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1449dd320cd252bdc7c8dea6feec99e445e1d20bac6bc93e67df845374ffb14a.png] 

So, 'TELEVISION' will be be written as '20-5-12-5-22-9-19-9-15-14'

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (2)".**
